additionalText.description: Defines the additional text of the component.

className.description:
CSS Class Name which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, overwriting CSS rules might break the component.

selected.description: Defines the selected state of the component.
selected.x-deprecationReason: Set the `value` property on items and use the `selectedValues` property on the parent `ui5-multi-combobox` instead for programmatic selection.

style.description:
Element style which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, some css properties might break the component.

text.description: Defines the text of the component.

value.description:
Defines the value of the component.

Use this property to associate a unique identifier with the item,
separate from the display text. This enables selecting items
programmatically via `selectedValues` on the parent MultiComboBox.

**Note:** Available since [v2.20.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.20.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

waitForDefine.description:
Defines whether the component should wait for the underlying custom element of the web component to be defined. This can be useful, for example, for using instance methods when mounting the component.

__Note:__ This adds a rendering cycle to your component.
